intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year fees, the placements we can use, and the ranks in our table, with official sites opened in {{year}}.
ICFAI Law School vs Uttaranchal University is a Dehradun integrated-law comparison. The recorded year fees are substantial, and we have not multiplied them into a five-year total.

sections.heading: ICFAI Law School vs Uttaranchal University for Integrated Law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ICFAI Law School if you want a CLAT-listed BA LLB (Hons) or BBA LLB (Hons), with a recorded Total Fees year figure of ₹4.35 lakh and India Today ranks of 28 in 2024 and 31 in 2023.

Choose Uttaranchal University if you want recorded year tuition of ₹2,37,560 for BA LLB (Hons) or BBA LLB (Hons), and you will treat the 2022 highest of ₹11 lakh as a historical row rather than a complete placement report.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For ICFAI Law School we hold ₹4.35 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for BA LLB (Hons), plus a separate ₹20,000 admission-fee year row. Do not quote the admission fee as the programme fee, and do not multiply the year total.
For Uttaranchal University we hold year tuition of ₹2,37,560 for BA LLB (Hons) and for BBA LLB (Hons). That is tuition for one year, not a confirmed official five-year total.
Confirm the current five-year notices on iudehradun.edu.in and uttaranchaluniversity.ac.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: ICFAI Law School has a 2016 BA LLB (Hons) row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest. That year is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.
Uttaranchal University has a 2022 BA LLB (Hons) row with a highest package of ₹11 lakh and no usable average recorded. Treat that as a historical highest, not a complete report.
Ask both campuses for a later official law-school placement note.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: ICFAI Law School is listed with CLAT. Uttaranchal University has no exam mapped on this page. Confirm each university's current official integrated-law admission note.
On our records, ICFAI Law School has India Today ranks of 28 in 2024 and 31 in 2023 for integrated law. Uttaranchal University has no rank row here. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private institutions, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
Both list BA LLB (Hons) and BBA LLB (Hons). Match the five-year course, internships and official fee schedule, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick ICFAI Law School if the India Today ranks and the CLAT-listed route matter more, after you have confirmed the official year or five-year fee rather than multiplying our row.
Pick Uttaranchal University if the recorded year tuition and that campus fit you, after official confirmation, without treating the 2022 highest as a full placement picture.
Do not decide from the 2016 ICFAI row.
